title: Dugway chief scientist reveals a huge subterranean facility and its shed entrance
place_text: west of Granite Peak, Dugway Proving Ground, Utah

tellings.quote: who informed this individual MS of the massive stiff or subterranean facility below Dougway

plain: A huge underground facility lies beneath Dugway Proving Ground, a US Army testing site in Utah, reached through an entrance hidden in a shed west of a mountain called Granite Peak. That is what the base's chief scientist told a person identified only by the initials MS, according to a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb and who relays the account second-hand. If true, it would point to a large secret site hidden under an already restricted range.
